items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: One time, Mr. Penman said, he's made beautiful, in the books, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know, one of them. It was down in Baraka. And this guy here, Mr. Chaplin, the little violin player, he played, Jesus, before my time. He talked about the Fantan and the Chinggadilly, Jesus Christ. Back, way back when, man. One time, he used to tie your horse and bike into the horse and wear the street, you know, the little things that don't work. You seen him, you know that? You know, stand there. I worked over there, man, I said, Santa Suey, see, man. With George Traai. Right way back, man. I talked to…
